description: This file contains test cases for channel policy security functions, including security configuration creation, warning collection, and validation of different configurations for the 'createRestrictSendersChannelSecurity' and 'createDangerousNameMatchingMutableAllowlistWarningCollector' functions.

methods.name: createRestrictSendersChannelSecurity

methods.name: createDangerousNameMatchingMutableAllowlistWarningCollector
methods.description: Creates a warning collector function for mutable allowlist entries with dangerous name matching, checking for entries that may be risky based on specific rules.
